sourceState: Gallery keeps the complete original local Active Theory runtime and fixed Cortana overlay. The Cortana overlay and all descendants are non-interactive so they cannot intercept Gallery input. The right desktop drag region is disabled only while Gallery is active, allowing the original Work and Contact controls, category filters, prompt field, cards, hover behavior, click navigation, and detail views to receive physical pointer input.
